thread:
emily_finance: Heads up — CloudVendor submitted a dispute: they say a reserved-capacity commitment credit for May wasn't applied to their AWS Marketplace settlement.

rafael_partners: which commitment? any contract ref?

mark_cloudvendor: ref CV-RC-2025: monthly reserved commit 500k tokens at discounted rate. We see our settlement shows the full public rate for 5/2026 usage. Claiming short-paid delta.

olivia_billing: pulling ledger now. Our marketplace ingestion shows two records: one tagged reserved_commitment and one tagged experiment_public_rate for same subscription. Looks like a pricing-experiment rollout (PR-912) toggled wrong price override on 2026-05-01.

billing-bot: :warning: Pricing override mismatch detected for subscription 555666777. Experiment PR-912 toggled to public_rate in prod on 2026-05-01.

emily_finance: Oof. So internal bug in experiment rollout gave CloudVendor public pricing instead of reserved commit. Quantify delta and propose remedy.

olivia_billing: delta = 500k tokens * ($0.0006 - $0.00045) = $75.00. That's the shortfall to partner. I'll prepare corrected settlement CSV.

nina_legal: contract CV-RC-2025 requires settlement at committed rate. We should refund/credit and document the experiment rollback. I'll draft language and require a signed acknowledgment for the one-time correction.

rafael_partners: partner will want quick fix + note to avoid recurrence. Recommend (A) immediate credit $75, (B) post-mortem on PR-912 and (C) a rollback guard added.

emily_finance: agree. Actions: Olivia issue $75 credit to partner-settlement account, Mark confirm acceptance, Engineering to add rollback guard for pricing experiments. Close in 2 business days.

mark_cloudvendor: accepting the credit. Please send corrected CSV and legal note for our records. Thanks for fast turnaround. :thumbsup:
